title: Step 2: Family and Home
ringkas: Dialog pendek tentang keluarga, rumah, dan kegiatan harian
goals: memahami **percakapan pendek tentang keluarga dan rumah**
mengisi kata yang hilang pada kalimat harian

lesson.text: Tahap 2 memakai percakapan pendek tentang keluarga, rumah, dan kegiatan harian. Fokuslah pada siapa melakukan apa dan di mana.

lesson.title: Strategi mendengarkan

lesson.title: Cara berlatih
lesson.text: Biasakan mendengar kata kerja kegiatan harian (wake up, get up, eat, go) dan tempat. Ulangi rekaman sambil membuat catatan satu kata.

practice.say: My father works in a bank. My mother is a teacher. I have one brother, and he goes to university.
My father works in a bank. My mother is a teacher. I have one brother, and he goes to university.
My room is on the second floor. There is a bed, a desk, and a small wardrobe. The window is next to the desk.

Every morning I get up at five thirty. I take a shower, eat breakfast, and walk to school with my sister.

practice.say: Every morning I get up at five thirty. I take a shower, eat breakfast, and walk to school with my sister.

Where is my bag? It is under the table. And my shoes? They are next to the door.
My brother is tall and thin. He likes football. He plays in the park every afternoon with his friends.
